decision.observation: Clear frame: goose at the gate's right side. The dirt path passes under the gate's bottom rail near the left-center, where the white bowl sits behind the lowest rail. Prior compound crouch attempts moved the pointer before pressing, so the click landed away from the gap.
decision.hypothesis: Positioning the pointer exactly on the under-rail gap first, then holding C (crouch) and pressing left (click occurs at the pointer's start position), will make the crouched goose push north under the bottom rail to the far side.
decision.memory: In compound control actions, the button press happens at the pointer's starting location, so pre-align the pointer before combining keys+button with zero movement.
